Faq.title: Questions, <hl>answered.</hl>
Faq.subtitle: Can't find what you're looking for? Open an issue on GitHub.

free.question: Is FlutterGuide really free?
free.answer: Yes. There's no premium tier and no account. The app is open source and supported by ads.

commercialUse.question: Can I use the sample code in my own projects?
commercialUse.answer: Yes, in personal and commercial projects alike. The samples exist to be copied.

ios.question: Is there an iOS version?
ios.answer: Not yet. FlutterGuide is currently available for Android on Google Play.

docs.question: Does it replace the official docs?
docs.answer: No, it complements them. Every widget links to its page on api.flutter.dev, and every package to pub.dev.

languages.question: Which languages does the app support?
languages.answer: English, Portuguese (Brazil) and Spanish. Switch in Settings, no restart needed.

updates.question: How often are new samples added?
updates.answer: Regularly. Each release adds samples and improvements; the changelog on GitHub lists them all.

contribute.question: How can I contribute?
contribute.answer: Open an issue or a pull request on GitHub. The contributing guide covers setup, the local quality gate and the commit convention.

PrivacyPolicy.title: Privacy Policy
PrivacyPolicy.description: How the FlutterGuide app collects, uses, and protects your data.
PrivacyPolicy.intro: This Privacy Policy explains how the FlutterGuide app (the "Application"), developed by Dário Matias ("Service Provider"), handles your information. The Application is free, with no account or sign-up required.
PrivacyPolicy.localPreferencesBody: The Application saves your favorites, theme (light/dark), code theme, and language preference directly on your device. This data is never transmitted to the Service Provider or anyone else, and is removed if you uninstall the Application.
PrivacyPolicy.advertisingBody: The Application shows ads through <admob>Google AdMob</admob>, which may collect device and advertising identifiers to deliver and measure ads. This data is handled by Google under its own policies, not by the Service Provider. See <privacy>Google's Privacy Policy</privacy> and <usage>how Google uses data from AdMob</usage> for details. You can manage ad personalization in your device's ad settings.
PrivacyPolicy.externalLinksBody: The Application links to external sites — the project's GitHub repository, its Play Store listing, and the developer's portfolio. Each of those sites has its own privacy practices, which this policy doesn't cover.
PrivacyPolicy.childrenBody: The Application is not directed at children under 13 and does not knowingly collect personal data from them.
PrivacyPolicy.changesBody: This Privacy Policy may be updated occasionally to reflect changes in the Application. Continued use of the Application after a change constitutes acceptance of the update.
PrivacyPolicy.contactBody: For any question about this policy, contact the Service Provider at <email>matiasdario75@gmail.com</email>.

noAccount.title: No account
noAccount.body: No sign-up and no profile: the app never asks who you are.
